srcZh: 最高人民检察院·检察日报
titleZh: 人工智能生成内容的著作权认定与有限保护
titleEn: Copyright Determination and Limited Protection of AI-Generated Content
sumZh: 作者提出对符合条件的AIGC成果给予著作权保护应遵循有限保护原则，紧扣权利归属与保护范围两大维度，坚持自然人创作本源主义与实质智力投入判断标准，按辅助汇编、创意启发、深度参与三类场景精细化认定。
sumEn: Argues that copyright protection for qualifying AIGC should follow a limited-protection principle, centering on rights attribution and scope while distinguishing auxiliary, inspiring, and deep-participation scenarios of human involvement.

srcZh: 最高人民检察院·检察日报
titleZh: 人工智能生成物知识产权保护的争议阐释与应然面向
titleEn: Disputes over IP Protection of AI-Generated Outputs and the Way Forward
sumZh: 从主体资格、客体范围、获取标准、权利归属四维度剖析AI生成物保护争议，主张有限拟制AI主体资格、区分纳入客体、分阶段动态化审查，并以“合同优先+贡献度推定”构建权属规则。
sumEn: Analyzes disputes over AI-generated outputs across subject qualification, object scope, grant standards, and rights attribution, proposing limited legal personhood for AI, differentiated inclusion of objects, and staged dynamic examination.

srcZh: 最高人民法院知识产权法庭
titleZh: AI时代 知识产权司法迎来新挑战
titleEn: IP Adjudication Faces New Challenges in the AI Era
sumZh: 梳理AI生成内容的独创性认定、训练数据版权边界、平台责任划分与AI模型权益保护等前沿裁判，展现我国知产审判“个案探索—规则提炼—体系构建”的渐进路径。
sumEn: Reviews frontier rulings on originality of AI content, copyright boundaries of training data, platform liability, and protection of AI models, illustrating China's progressive path from case-by-case exploration to rule formation.

srcZh: 知识产权律师网·人民司法
titleZh: 人工智能生成内容的著作权司法认定：演进逻辑、现实困境与规则建构
titleEn: Judicial Determination of AIGC Copyright: Evolution, Dilemmas and Rule Construction
sumZh: 梳理AIGC著作权认定的司法演进，提出以“人类中心主义”为根本、确立AI参与主动披露义务与“过程举证+实质贡献”二元审查路径，并按文、图、视听、交互类型细化独创性分层标准。
sumEn: Proposes a human-centric framework with mandatory disclosure of AI involvement and a dual-track review of process evidence and substantive contribution, refining layered originality standards by content type.

titleZh: 张平：人工智能生成内容著作权合法性的制度难题及其解决路径
titleEn: Zhang Ping: Institutional Difficulties of AIGC Copyright Legality and Solutions
sumZh: 北大教授张平主张以“客体判断说”认定AIGC作品属性，将著作权归属使用者、署名与著作权分离，并通过合理使用、集体管理、开放授权等多元工具化解训练数据合法性障碍。
sumEn: Prof. Zhang Ping advocates an object-based test for AIGC works, assigning copyright to users while separating authorship, and resolving training-data legitimacy through fair use, collective management and open licensing.

titleZh: 人工智能+知识产权，创造协同发展新优势
titleEn: AI Plus IP: Creating New Synergies
sumZh: 解读江苏《人工智能与知识产权双向赋能行动方案》，提出从要素保障、专利布局、成果转化、品牌建设、侵权保护五维度推动AI与知识产权“1+1>2”协同，构建AI新业态保护规则。
sumEn: Interprets Jiangsu's action plan for mutual empowerment of AI and IP, advancing protection rules for new AI business forms across factor support, patent layout, commercialization, branding and infringement protection.

titleZh: 人工智能能否经受“发明人”考验？
titleEn: Can AI Pass the Inventor Test?
sumZh: 我国首例AI“发明人”资格案认定：AI系统不属于民法规定的民事主体，不能成为专利法上的发明人，为全球性问题提供了中国答案；崔国斌、王迁等专家从制度逻辑展开评析。
sumEn: China's first ruling on AI inventorship holds that an AI system is not a civil-law subject and cannot be a patent inventor, with expert commentary on the institutional logic behind the answer.

titleZh: 加快建立人工智能训练数据合理使用制度
titleEn: Accelerating a Fair-Use Regime for AI Training Data
sumZh: 认为大模型竞争实质是数据供给与治理能力竞争，主张建立分类分级、授权留痕、来源可溯、风险评估与争议救济的训练数据合理使用制度，并统筹国内规则与国际兼容。
sumEn: Argues that model competition is ultimately about data governance, calling for a classified, traceable and risk-based fair-use regime for training data that reconciles domestic rules with international compatibility.

titleZh: 寻求AI使用与版权保护的动态平衡
titleEn: Seeking a Dynamic Balance Between AI Use and Copyright Protection
sumZh: 提出“AI是工具、人是主体”的裁判立场，主张“谁投入、谁享有”的权属原则，并建议增设“文本与数据挖掘例外”、建立“选择退出”机制与集体管理授权平台。
sumEn: Proposes an 'AI-as-tool, human-as-subject' stance with attribution by contribution, and recommends a text-and-data-mining exception, an opt-out mechanism, and collective-management licensing platforms.

titleZh: AI时代，对著作权法的前瞻思考
titleEn: Forward-Looking Reflections on Copyright Law in the AI Era
sumZh: 万勇、蒋舸、熊文聪三位学者围绕AI生成物可版权性、训练数据合理使用、开源边界展开对话，认为应回归“接触+实质性相似”判断，并以市场失灵视角理解合理使用。
sumEn: Scholars Wan Yong, Jiang Ge and Xiong Wencong debate AIGC copyrightability, training-data fair use and open-source boundaries, advocating a return to 'access plus substantial similarity' tests.

titleZh: 人工智能训练数据的版权争议及合规方案
titleEn: Copyright Disputes over AI Training Data and Compliance Approaches
sumZh: 梳理AI训练数据版权正反两派观点与国内外立法判例，认为“合理使用”是现阶段相对优选路径，并建议企业通过合法授权、合成数据、数据供应商合作等方式降低合规风险。
sumEn: Reviews competing positions and comparative law on AI training-data copyright, arguing fair use is the preferable near-term path and advising compliance through licensing, synthetic data and vendor cooperation.

titleZh: 以知识产权助推新质生产力发展
titleEn: Promoting New Quality Productive Forces Through IP
sumZh: 从完善法律制度体系、加强司法保障、壮大法治人才三方面论述知识产权助推新质生产力，强调完善新领域新业态规则和本土资源保护，把科技创新成果予以产权化。
sumEn: Argues IP fuels new quality productive forces by refining the legal regime, strengthening judicial protection and cultivating talent, while propertyizing scientific achievements and protecting local resources.

titleZh: 加强知识产权司法保护 助推新质生产力加快发展
titleEn: Strengthening Judicial IP Protection to Accelerate New Quality Productive Forces
sumZh: 最高法院副院长陶凯元提出从加强科技创新成果保护、科技创新主体保护、营造法治环境、健全体制机制四方面，以公正高效司法护航新质生产力发展。
sumEn: SPC Vice President Tao Kaiyuan calls for stronger judicial protection of innovations and innovators, a sound legal environment, and better institutions to safeguard new quality productive forces.

srcZh: 国家知识产权局·专家解读
titleZh: 戚湧：知识产权数智化治理赋能新质生产力发展
titleEn: Qi Yong: Digital-Intelligent IP Governance Empowers New Quality Productive Forces
sumZh: 从创造、运用、保护、服务、安全五维度提出知识产权数智化治理对策，主张以智能工具革新创造范式、以区块链和智能合约优化转化与保护，赋能新质生产力发展。
sumEn: Proposes digital-intelligent IP governance across creation, application, protection, service and security, using AI tools, blockchain and smart contracts to empower new quality productive forces.

srcZh: 知产财经网·中国应用法学
srcEn: IPEconomy / China Journal of Applied Law
titleZh: 徐俊：新质生产力发展下的知识产权保护对策研究
titleEn: Xu Jun: IP Protection Strategies for Developing New Quality Productive Forces
sumZh: 上海高院法官徐俊指出数字经济竞争正演变为以数据和算法为核心的生态竞争，主张秉持严格保护、开放包容、统筹协调理念，从科技创新、产业升级、市场发展、社会治理四维度分类施策。
sumEn: Judge Xu Jun argues digital-economy competition centers on data and algorithms, advocating strict, open and coordinated protection with differentiated measures across innovation, industry, market and governance.

titleZh: 2026全球数字经济大会知识产权专题论坛：知识产权赋能新质生产力发展
titleEn: 2026 Global Digital Economy Conference IP Forum: IP Empowers New Quality Productive Forces
sumZh: 论坛围绕“知识产权赋能新质生产力”与数据要素权益保障，强调加大关键核心技术、AI、具身智能、数据知识产权司法保护力度，完善数据知识产权规则与统一登记平台。
sumEn: The forum highlights stronger judicial protection for core technologies, AI, embodied intelligence and data IP, while improving data IP rules and a unified registration platform.

titleZh: 新法护航品牌发展 法治规范商标秩序
titleEn: New Trademark Law Safeguards Brand Development and Regulates Trademark Order
sumZh: 专访法工委专家解读新修订商标法：首次全面修订体现从“局部修改”到“系统完善”转变，聚焦恶意注册、驰名商标保护、使用导向、代理机构监管等核心问题。
sumEn: Interviews NPC experts on the first comprehensive revision of the Trademark Law, covering bad-faith filings, well-known mark protection, use-oriented reform and agency oversight.

srcZh: 国家知识产权局·专家解读
titleZh: 余俊：系统重塑商标产权保护制度
titleEn: Yu Jun: Systematically Reshaping the Trademark Property Protection Regime
sumZh: 北京化工大学教授余俊提出新商标法实现“产权保护先于行政管理、实体条件先于程序规则、真实使用先于形式注册”三重校正，推动商标法成为市场经济基础性财产制度。
sumEn: Prof. Yu Jun argues the new law corrects three orders of priority—property protection over administration, substance over procedure, real use over formal registration—making it a foundational property regime.

titleZh: 管育鹰：新修订商标法对“心机商标”的治理及其实施路径
titleEn: Guan Yuying: Governance of Deceptive Trademarks under the Revised Law
sumZh: 社科院研究员管育鹰剖析“心机商标”的误导机制，主张商标审查应站在消费者认知视角从源头阻断，并落实新增第五十六条行政处罚与投诉举报机制的全链条治理。
sumEn: Researcher Guan Yuying analyzes deceptive trademark practices and urges consumer-perspective examination at the source, combined with new administrative penalties and complaint mechanisms.

titleZh: IP会客厅·让商标注册回归制度本源——商标法修订亮点解读
titleEn: IP Salon: Returning Trademark Registration to Its Institutional Purpose
sumZh: 刘友华、张洋两位专家解读商标法修订：构建“事前审查—事中审理—事后追责—代理连带”四位一体闭环规制，强化使用义务，推动商标制度从“注册即权利”转向“使用才是底盘”。
sumEn: Experts Liu Youhua and Zhang Yang interpret the revision as a closed loop against bad-faith filings and a shift from registration-based rights to use-based rights.

titleZh: 2026品牌日商标品牌发展会议：商标品牌与竞争力
titleEn: 2026 China Brand Day Trademark Development Conference
sumZh: 会议围绕“商标品牌与竞争力”主题，钱明辉提出以“五化链条”推进文化品牌资产建设，与会专家就品牌国际化、马德里体系运用、AI时代品牌信任壁垒等展开研讨。
sumEn: Under the theme of trademark brands and competitiveness, experts discuss cultural brand asset building, Madrid-system use, and brand trust barriers in the AI era.

titleZh: INTA中国首席代表苏红：以知识产权护航中国品牌高质量出海
titleEn: INTA China Chief Representative Su Hong: IP Safeguards Chinese Brands Going Global
sumZh: 苏红指出中国品牌出海呈现治理前置、跨法域落地、组合式保护等实践，强调AI与数字品牌资产保护中的规则推动，并介绍INTA为中小企业出海提供的全方位支持体系。
sumEn: Su Hong highlights governance-first, cross-jurisdictional and portfolio-based protection practices, and INTA's support system for SMEs navigating AI and digital brand-asset risks.

titleZh: 知识产权护航民营企业“出海”
titleEn: IP Protects Private Enterprises Going Global
sumZh: 在知识产权年会论坛上，企业代表提出出海应把标准法规政策纳入统一管理、加强风险预警与快速反应，并以法律、技术、商业、产业、国际多重视角打造高价值专利布局。
sumEn: Industry representatives advise integrating standards and regulations into unified management, strengthening risk warning, and building high-value patent portfolios from legal, technical, commercial and international perspectives.

titleZh: 破圈出海 中国品牌加速登陆全球市场
titleEn: Chinese Brands Accelerate Global Expansion
sumZh: 聚焦中国品牌从“卖产品”到“建生态”的转型，指出新一代企业更注重海外实体、品牌深耕与本地化运营，并强调其正通过积累自主知识产权重塑全球认知。
sumEn: Highlights Chinese brands' shift from selling products to building ecosystems, with greater focus on local operations and proprietary IP that is reshaping global perceptions.

titleZh: 加强地理标志保护运用 为乡村振兴蓄势赋能
titleEn: Strengthening GI Protection and Use to Empower Rural Revitalization
sumZh: 冯晓青建议尽快制定地理标志专门法律法规，健全专门保护与商标保护相协调的统一制度；各地探索“地理标志+金融”“地理标志+文旅”等融合模式带动县域富民产业。
sumEn: Prof. Feng Xiaoqing calls for dedicated GI legislation and a unified regime coordinating special and trademark protection, while regions explore GI-plus-finance and GI-plus-tourism models.

titleZh: 企业基于产业链上中下游协同的专利布局
titleEn: Patent Layout Based on Upstream-Midstream-Downstream Industrial Chain Collaboration
sumZh: 陈易华构建“识别产业特征—实施协同布局—动态优化调整”实操体系，提出上游锚定基础性专利、中游侧重工艺专利、下游聚焦应用专利的分层布局与跨环节协同机制。
sumEn: Chen Yihua builds a practical system of identifying industrial features, coordinated layout and dynamic adjustment, with layered strategies for upstream, midstream and downstream patents.

titleZh: 中小企业专利布局与知识产权风险防控
titleEn: Patent Layout and IP Risk Prevention for SMEs
sumZh: 分析中小企业专利布局的战略价值与现实困境，提出强化专利检索与侵权预警、完善申请维护运营管理、构建合规管理与纠纷应对体系等风险防控路径。
sumEn: Analyzes the strategic value and difficulties of SME patent layout, proposing patent searching, infringement warning, lifecycle management and compliance systems for risk prevention.

titleZh: 从技术转化到战略赋能——把握高价值专利培育与产业化的新要求
titleEn: From Technology Transfer to Strategic Empowerment: New Requirements for High-Value Patent Cultivation
sumZh: 肖尤丹从使命、格局、路径三维度解读“十五五”规划，指出高价值专利培育从“融入产业”转向“赋能产业”、从机制建设转向能力提升，并强化需求侧牵引。
sumEn: Xiao Youdan interprets the 15th Five-Year Plan along mission, structure and path, noting high-value patents shift from integrating with industry to empowering it, with demand-side pull.

titleZh: 国家知识产权局关于修改《专利审查指南》的决定
titleEn: CNIPA Decision on Amending the Patent Examination Guidelines
sumZh: 新修订审查指南自2026年1月1日施行，新增人工智能伦理审查与创造性审查示例、算法类商业规则不予授权、比特流审查等规定，并明确发明人须为自然人。
sumEn: The amended examination guidelines add AI ethics and inventiveness examples, exclude algorithm-based business rules from patentability, and require inventors to be natural persons.

titleZh: 扩能提质！推动知识产权服务业高质量发展
titleEn: Expanding Capacity and Quality: Promoting High-Quality IP Services
sumZh: 宋河发等专家认为知识产权服务业是高质量创造与运用的重要支撑，需坚持专业化、市场化、国际化，主动嵌入创新链产业链，提升标准必要专利与专利池建设能力。
sumEn: Experts argue IP services underpin high-quality creation and use, calling for specialization, market orientation and internationalization, with deeper embedding into innovation and industrial chains.

titleZh: 我国首部《标准必要专利反垄断指引》亮点解析
titleEn: Analysis of China's First Anti-Monopoly Guidelines for SEPs
sumZh: 从九大亮点解析《指引》，涵盖全链条监管、许可费率计算释明、禁令救济反垄断规制、市场界定留白、专利联营垄断协议分析等，展望SEP执法与司法实践互动。
sumEn: Analyzes nine highlights of the SEP anti-monopoly guidelines, including full-chain supervision, royalty calculation disclosure, injunction regulation and patent-pool monopoly analysis.

srcZh: 上海专利商标事务所有限公司
titleZh: 从《标准必要专利反垄断指引》看SEP全球治理的中国思路
titleEn: China's Approach to Global SEP Governance Seen Through the Guidelines
sumZh: 认为《指引》体现发展与规范并重、兼顾权利人与实施方利益平衡，构建事前事中事后全链条监管，细化FRAND原则与许可费规则，为SEP全球治理贡献中国方案。
sumEn: Argues the guidelines balance development and regulation, build full-chain supervision, refine FRAND and royalty rules, and contribute a Chinese approach to global SEP governance.

titleZh: 破解知识产权转化难题在于“贯通”
titleEn: Cracking the IP Commercialization Puzzle Lies in Integration
sumZh: 马一德认为破解转化难题关键在于贯通技术、专利、资本、市场和服务，主张统筹供给端、需求端、服务端、制度端改革，跨越成果商业化的“达尔文之海”。
sumEn: Ma Yide argues the key to commercialization is integrating technology, patents, capital, markets and services, with coordinated supply, demand, service and institutional reform.

titleZh: 大力促进知识产权价值实现
titleEn: Vigorously Promoting the Realization of IP Value
sumZh: 申长雨针对“不能转、不愿转、不敢转、不会转、不便转”五大堵点，提出深化权益分配改革、打通转化关键堵点、培育要素市场、推进强链增效、完善服务体系等举措。
sumEn: CNIPA chief Shen Changyu targets five barriers to patent commercialization, proposing deeper rights-allocation reform, clearing key bottlenecks, and cultivating the IP factor market.

titleZh: 人民网评：从“量”入“质”，知识产权赋能创新发展
titleEn: People's Daily Online Review: From Quantity to Quality, IP Empowers Innovation
sumZh: 以2025年专利、商标、品牌、地理标志、数据知识产权数据为据，指出我国知识产权正从规模扩张转向质量提升，赋能边界持续延伸，为创新驱动发展提供制度保障。
sumEn: Citing 2025 patent, trademark, brand, GI and data-IP figures, argues China's IP work is shifting from scale to quality, with expanding empowerment of innovation.

titleZh: 着力提升知识产权运用效益——访申长雨
titleEn: Improving IP Application Efficiency: Interview with Shen Changyu
sumZh: 申长雨系统阐述专利转化运用专项行动成效，提出以“盘活存量+赋能中小企业+强链增效”为主线，构建转化运用长效机制，破解“不敢转、不愿转、不能转”难题。
sumEn: Shen Changyu outlines the special action's achievements and a long-term mechanism around activating stock patents, empowering SMEs and strengthening industrial chains.

titleZh: 让更多高校科技成果尽快转化为现实生产力
titleEn: Turning More University Achievements into Productive Forces
sumZh: 解读教育部高校专利转化运用攻坚行动，专家点评建立专利全生命周期管理、多渠道对接、“先使用后付费”与开放许可、以转化贡献为导向的评价激励机制等举措。
sumEn: Interprets the Ministry of Education's campaign, with expert commentary on full-lifecycle patent management, multi-channel matching, pay-after-use and open licensing, and conversion-oriented evaluation.

titleZh: 如何助力“知产”变“资产”？陆家嘴金融沙龙热议新路径
titleEn: Turning IP into Assets: Lujiazui Financial Salon on New Paths
sumZh: 围绕知识产权价值评估、交易平台、金融产品创新与多方协同，探讨破解“知产”变“资产”三大瓶颈，并分享国资平台代持医院股权、知识产权证券化等创新实践。
sumEn: Discusses evaluation, trading platforms, financial product innovation and coordination to overcome three bottlenecks in IP commercialization, including hospital-equity trusts and IP securitization.

titleZh: 奋进“十五五”推动知识产权事业高质量发展
titleEn: Advancing High-Quality IP Development in the 15th Five-Year Period
sumZh: 透过“十五五”规划主要指标，展望高价值专利、专利密集型产业、知识产权使用费、地理标志产值、保护满意度等目标的提升路径与政策导向。
sumEn: Looks ahead through the plan's key indicators, mapping paths for high-value patents, patent-intensive industries, IP royalties, GI output and protection satisfaction.

titleZh: 知识产权如何服务国家发展大局？四个维度读懂“十五五”新布局
titleEn: How IP Serves National Development: Four Dimensions of the 15th Five-Year Layout
sumZh: 国家知识产权局知识产权发展研究中心主任刘新民从保护、运用、治理、国际合作四维度解读“十五五”规划，详解新兴领域规则、行政裁决、转化堵点与涉外纠纷应对。
sumEn: CNIPA research chief Liu Xinmin interprets the plan across protection, application, governance and international cooperation, covering frontier rules, administrative adjudication and overseas disputes.

titleZh: 从“半年45.3万件发明专利”看中国经济高质量发展逻辑
titleEn: Reading China's High-Quality Development Logic from 453,000 Invention Patents
sumZh: 以上半年专利数据为切口，指出知识产权正从“量”向“质”跃升，创新向企业集聚、向新兴领域延伸、向服务业拓展，知识产权使用费出口成为服务贸易新名片。
sumEn: Uses H1 patent data to argue IP is shifting from quantity to quality, with innovation concentrating in enterprises and emerging fields, and IP royalty exports becoming a new services-trade card.

titleZh: 为“十五五”高质量发展贡献知识产权力量
titleEn: Contributing IP Strength to High-Quality Development in the 15th Five-Year Period
sumZh: 全国两会代表委员围绕“十五五”规划纲要，提出优化知识产权评价机制、破解成果转化体制机制障碍、发展知识产权服务业等建议，护航科技创新与产业创新深度融合。
sumEn: NPC and CPPCC deputies propose optimizing IP evaluation, removing commercialization barriers and developing IP services to deepen the integration of technological and industrial innovation.

titleZh: 2026年全国知识产权局局长会议工作报告
titleEn: 2026 National IP Administrators Conference Work Report
sumZh: 总结“十四五”成就并部署2026年八大重点工作，强调加快提升创造质量、大力提升保护水平、加速释放运用效益、深化国际合作，实现“十五五”良好开局。
sumEn: Summarizes 14th Five-Year achievements and sets eight priorities for 2026, emphasizing creation quality, protection, application benefits and international cooperation.

titleZh: 专家声音：数据赋权的法律实践评价与制度创建构想
titleEn: Expert Voices: Evaluating Data Rights Practice and Designing the Regime
sumZh: 吴汉东等专家评述数据产权制度：中国数据产权建设循“政策指引—制度实践—立法确立”路径，未来“数据产权条例”应涵盖主体、客体、权益、登记、合同、救济等规范构成。
sumEn: Prof. Wu Handong and others review data-rights regimes, arguing China's path proceeds from policy to practice to legislation, with a future data-rights regulation covering subject, object, registration and remedies.

titleZh: 《数据知识产权登记证》在司法程序中可具备初步证据效力
titleEn: Data IP Registration Certificates Carry Prima Facie Evidentiary Effect
sumZh: 全国首例涉数据知识产权登记证竞争案二审明确：登记证可作为数据集合财产性权益及收集合法性的初步证据，并确立“分类保护、阶梯适用”的数据权益司法保护路径。
sumEn: The first case involving a data IP registration certificate holds it serves as prima facie evidence of property interests and lawful collection, establishing a tiered judicial protection path for data.

titleZh: 推动构建数据知识产权保护规则
titleEn: Advancing the Construction of Data IP Protection Rules
sumZh: 申卫星、冯晓青、姚佳、黄灿等专家指出数据知识产权规则存在统一性不足、审查标准不高等问题，建议明确立法宗旨原则、完善登记制度、建立协同共治的权益保护机制。
sumEn: Experts flag gaps in uniformity and examination standards of data IP rules, proposing clearer legislative principles, a better registration system and collaborative rights protection.

titleZh: 专家解读：数据产权登记的中国方案
titleEn: Expert Reading: China's Approach to Data Property Registration
sumZh: 北大教授常鹏翱解读《数据产权登记工作指引（试行）》，从登记机构社会化市场化、登记对象全面性、合理审慎审查、证明力、体系化等五方面解析数据产权登记的中国方案。
sumEn: Prof. Chang Peng'ao interprets the data-property registration guideline across institutional selection, object coverage, prudent review, evidentiary effect and systematization.

srcZh: 最高人民检察院·检察日报
titleZh: “多角度+全方位”筑牢商业秘密司法保护屏障
titleEn: Building a Multi-Dimensional Judicial Protection Shield for Trade Secrets
sumZh: 马一德、陆锋、何庆仁三位专家分别从民法保护、检察综合履职、刑事规制三维度研讨，主张以保护目的统领司法实践、深化“一案四查”、严密数智时代刑事法网。
sumEn: Ma Yide, Lu Feng and He Qingren discuss trade-secret protection from civil, prosecutorial and criminal perspectives, urging purpose-driven practice and tighter criminal regulation in the digital age.

titleZh: 以法护密 保障创新——《商业秘密保护规定》全面解读
titleEn: Protecting Secrets to Safeguard Innovation: Reading the Trade Secret Regulation
sumZh: 解读《商业秘密保护规定》：细化数字新场景客体、完善“接触+实质相同”推定、明确境外侵权管辖、构建“事前预防—事中规制—事后救济”全链条行政保护体系。
sumEn: Interprets the trade-secret regulation, refining digital-scene objects, presumption rules, extraterritorial jurisdiction and a full-chain administrative protection system.

titleZh: 2026《商业秘密保护规定》亮点解读
titleEn: Highlights of the 2026 Trade Secret Protection Regulation
sumZh: 从清单式认定、场景化侵权、行政程序完善、法律责任强化四方面解读新规，指出其通过“相似+接触”推定、举证责任转移等大幅降低企业行政维权门槛。
sumEn: Interprets the new regulation's list-based identification, scenario-based infringement, improved procedures and tougher liability, lowering the administrative enforcement threshold for enterprises.
